**Clarifying business details**

I need to clarify several aspects for the user’s request: specifically, what business or product they’re referring to, the target market, geography, ideal customer profile (ICP), pricing, and distribution channel. Without this information, I can't effectively move forward. It’s essential to ask targeted questions to gather all the necessary details. I’ll use the `send_message_to_user` function to pose these questions in a clear and straightforward manner.

To get you your first 10 customers, I need a few specifics so I can build a concrete lead list + outreach plan (and then execute it). Answer these as briefly as possible:

1) What are you selling? (1–2 sentence description + link if any)
2) Who is the ideal customer? (industry, job title, company size, geography)
3) What problem do you solve + your main promise/result?
4) Price point and model? (one-time, monthly, contract size)
5) What’s your current proof? (case studies, portfolio, demo, beta users—anything)
6) Delivery capacity: can you onboard 10 customers this month? (yes/no, constraints)
7) Where can you sell? (website domain, LinkedIn profile, email domain; any restrictions)
8) Do you want customers via: (A) cold email, (B) LinkedIn, (C) Upwork/Fiverr, (D) local/networking, (E) ads, (F) partnerships) — pick up to 2.

If you reply with just #1 and #2, I can already start generating a targeted list of 30–50 prospects to convert the first 10.

1) I build custom Notion dashboards that auto-pull data from Shopify, Stripe, and Google Analytics—essentially a lightweight, founder-friendly “data warehouse” without the dev time. Live demo at notionmetrics.co

2) E-commerce founders (Shopify store owners) doing $50k–$2 M/month, US/Canada, 1–20 employees, Founder/CEO title.

3) You stop juggling a dozen CSV exports and can see real-time revenue, top SKUs, and ad spend ROI in one place. Promise: “Know your numbers in 5 min/week and save 4 hrs/month of spreadsheet hell.”

4) One-time setup $1,200 (paid 50 % up front, 50 % on delivery). Optional $99/month for data-source maintenance.

5) Built 12 dashboards for founders in my indie-hacker circle; two testimonials on the site (notionmetrics.co/case-studies). One user (PawPaw Pet Supplies) says it saved them $700/month on a BI tool.

6) Yes—max 2 dashboards/week, so 10 customers = 5-week backlog; I’m solo but can handle it.

7) Sell via my domain (notionmetrics.co), LinkedIn (/in/daniel-kim-notion), and Gmail (daniel@notionmetrics.co). No platform restrictions.

8) Cold email + LinkedIn

Perfect. I have everything I need. You're selling high-touch custom Notion dashboards to e-commerce founders at $1,200/setup. You can handle 10 customers over 5 weeks. I'll build a plan to:

1. Research and identify 30–50 qualified Shopify store owners in your ICP (US/Canada, $50k–$2M/mo revenue, 1–20 employees)
2. Validate them (LinkedIn, company signals, engagement potential)
3. Create a cold email + LinkedIn outreach sequence
4. Execute outreach to convert 10 customers
5. Track pipeline and close rate

I'm ready to move to execution. Calling set_plan now.
